products.name: Diligen Contract Analysis Platform

products.notes: Core product for law firms, legal service providers, and corporate legal teams. Supports M&A due diligence, lease review, finance agreements, privacy/NDA review, oil & gas contracts, and audit/compliance use cases. Pre-trained models for hundreds of clause types; allows custom model training on customer data.

flags: Diligen does not maintain a dedicated public trust center or security certifications page on their domain
Third-party vendor databases mention SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, but no evidence was found on diligen.com to verify these certification claims
Diligen positions itself as helping customers with GDPR compliance but does not publicly claim GDPR compliance for its own service
The privacy policy is vague on data retention specifics: it states retention 'as long as account is active or as needed' but does not define specific retention periods
The privacy policy allows system training on customer contract data but does not clearly explain whether that training improves only customer-specific models or the general platform model
Despite servicing global clients, Diligen publishes no documentation of data residency choices (US, EU, Canada, Australia); the privacy policy only mentions the US and unspecified other countries
Diligen uses Google reCAPTCHA for bot detection, which involves sharing visitor behavior data with Google for analysis
